messages:
Sophie: :wave: Quick sync — FastCloud is asking for a Redwood reference architecture + Terraform module we can bundle into their marketplace catalog. They also want AmpereX instance profiles called out. Can we scope what needs to ship for an MVP (module + sample + docs + CI) and owners?
Liam: I can own the Terraform module and packaging. Will need Arjun for the infra knobs and Claire for the sample app + docs.
Arjun: FYI AmpereX requires a kernel flag we surface via launch template. Also we should pin to the Ubuntu image family they validated. I can provide the recommended instance types and a small init script.
Claire: I'll put together a tiny end-to-end sample (inference server + client) and a README with usage + expected perf numbers. Will need the module outputs for endpoint IP and LB DNS.
Sophie: Great. Nora, any legal/checklist items for a marketplace listing we should preempt?
Nora: Standard: export controls + third-party notices. Also we need a short support statement and a contact email for FastCloud listing metadata. I'll draft a template.
Liam: Proposed deliverables and owners:
- terraform module (modules/fastcloud) — Liam
- sample app repo (examples/fastcloud-amperex) — Claire
- infra config / launch templates — Arjun
- docs + marketplace metadata — Sophie + Nora
- CI that builds module package and runs smoke tests — Liam + Arjun
Sophie: Timeline? FastCloud wants a preview next Wed (6 business days). Can we aim for an internal alpha by Tue morning?
Arjun: I can have launch template + AMI guidance by Monday EOD.
Claire: Sample app skeleton by Monday, full README + perf numbers by Tue morning.
Liam: Module skeleton + initial outputs by Monday night. I can wire CI to run `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against a small test account.
MarketplaceBot: :white_check_mark: Reminder: marketplace bundle must include a manifest.json (schema v2), package checksum, and a signed EULA. See https://fastcloud.marketplace/docs/bundles
Sophie: Important acceptance criteria for the alpha:
- module supports configurable instance_type, AmpereX profile, and user_data
- CI runs smoke deploy and verifies HTTP /health endpoint
- docs include step-by-step marketplace packaging notes and required fields for FastCloud UI
- legal template added to repo
Liam: Quick module usage snippet I'll include in README:
```hcl
module "redwood_fastcloud" {
  source  = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-modules//modules/fastcloud"
  version = "v0.1.0"
  region  = var.region
  instance_type = "amperex.c1.large"
}
```
Claire: For the sample app I'll include a small inference container + systemd unit and a test client that hits `/predict` with a canned prompt. Keeps smoke tests fast.
Arjun: CI note: use a sandbox FastCloud account with a budget guard. Add a `destroy` step to avoid costs. Also tag resources with `team:redwood` and `partner:fastcloud` for billing.
Sophie: Who can open the tracking GH org repo/issue? Let's create a single epic and link PRs.
Liam: I'll open `redwood/fastcloud-marketplace` and add the epic + issues for module/sample/ci/docs today.
Nora: I'll post the legal template as a PR once the docs repo exists.
Sophie: OK — next sync tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop in #partnerships. :rocket:
Liam: sounds good, starting the repo now.
Claire: adding sample skeleton in a branch — will link the PR when ready.
Arjun: I'll drop the launch template JSON and AMI id in the repo as soon as validated.
MarketplaceBot: Deploy checklist reminder: manifest.json, checksum, EULA, support_contact, automated smoke test results (optional but recommended).
Sophie: Thanks all — keeping this short. Meeting notes will be pasted in the epic. :hammer_and_wrench:
